{{Top|ca|leg}}
'''Dakar Sol''' was an [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] individual in the service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who led fellow enslaved individuals in a [[Malachor V rebellion|rebellion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malachor V]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Sol's rebellion was considered to have been the largest of its kind in the history of the Empire.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Rebelling Slaves}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dakar Sol was mentioned in the Codex entry for "Rebelling Slaves" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
